speaker: FEATHERWINGS
text: Seasonal shutdowns during peak migration periods are now in effect and are successfully preventing bird fatalities.

speaker: LEGAL ADVISOR
text: This intervention represents one of the strongest forms of compliance with international biodiversity obligations under SDG 15.

speaker: ENERGY MINISTER
text: However, energy production has declined during peak demand periods as a direct result of the shutdown schedule.

speaker: ENERGY MINISTER
text: This reduction is placing pressure on grid stability and slowing progress toward national renewable energy targets under SDG 7 and SDG 13.

speaker: LEGAL ADVISOR
text: The current situation reflects a trade-off between biodiversity protection and energy security commitments.

speaker: ENERGY MINISTER
text: Further system adjustments may require compensatory infrastructure or alternative energy capacity planning.

speaker: ENERGY MINISTER
text: The implementation report is complete. The Cabinet will now review the combined policy outcomes.
